map.屏幕上出现用某种颜色写的颜色词（如红字写「蓝」），你需要忽略字义、按墨色作答。这: A color word appears on screen written in a different color (for example the word "blue" written in red ink), and you must ignore the meaning and answer by the ink color. This conflict between meaning and color produces the famous Stroop effect, used to assess selective attention and interference suppression.
